criteria.criterion: docs/design/study-capability-m1.md answers every finding in docs/design/reviews/study-capability-m1-review-1.md, with a response table naming each finding and its resolution.
criteria.evidence: I read the design doc. Its §10.2 table has 17 rows (M1–M7, m1–m8, n1, n2), matching the review's count of 7 major, 8 minor and 2 nits. Each row names a resolution and the section that holds it. I spot-checked the sections each row points to (§2.1 containment, redaction and caps; §4 study.run/1 fields; §5.1 regions, sub-units and evaluated-by; §5.4 non-waivable evidence rules, contradicts links and quote checks; §6 A2-D and the A3 bold row; the §5.3 example fix). The text is there in each.

criteria.criterion: Each BRIEF.md reference names the BRIEF.md commit or a stated snapshot, so a reader can find it without job records (fixes the earlier n2 nit).
criteria.evidence: The header (lines 8–11) and the n2 row pin every reference to commit c6004fd556094a943f98834c83f282a98390130d and tell the reader to run `git show c6004fd:BRIEF.md`. `git log` shows that c6004fd is the base commit of Athena's rebuilt two-commit verification repository, and its date is 2000-01-01. The brief says the real base is 9102a2bb2e90. That hash is not in this repository (`git show` returns 'unknown revision'), and the real repository will not contain c6004fd either. So the reference a reader is told to follow will not resolve. The phrase 'the base commit of this revision' is the only usable pointer, and it is undercut by the wrong hash.

criteria.criterion: The §10.2 response table cites BRIEF.md:299 directly on the redaction row.
criteria.evidence: The M6 row reads 'Redaction before storage, as `BRIEF.md:299` asks that runs be "recorded, redacted, and replayable"'. BRIEF.md line 299 contains that phrase; I read the file.

criteria.criterion: §5.4 and §8.1 state that the 'Inferred shown as stated' rule's planted-fault test is deferred until the Pages template design exists, and the re-review is asked to confirm that order.
criteria.evidence: The 'Test order' paragraph in §5.4 says the test is 'deferred until the Pages template design exists' and that 'The re-review is asked to confirm that order'. §8 (which has no §8.1 subsection) says the test depends on the Pages design and is deferred. §10.3 asks the re-review to confirm the order again.

summary: Fail. The revision answers all 17 review findings (M1–M7, m1–m8, n1–n2) in a §10.2 response table, and the design text backs each answer. The redaction row cites BRIEF.md:299. The deferral of the "Inferred shown as stated" test, and the request that the re-review confirm it, appear in §5.4, §8 and §10.3. git diff and git status, which I ran, show that only the design doc and CHANGELOG.md changed and that BRIEF.md and the review file are untouched. One problem fails the job: the fix for the earlier n2 nit pins every BRIEF.md reference to commit c6004fd556…. That is the base commit of Athena's rebuilt two-commit verification repository, not the real base, which the brief gives as 9102a2bb2e90. So the `git show c6004fd:BRIEF.md` instruction in the doc will not work in the real repository, and criterion 2 (a stable reference a reader can find without job records) is not met. The fix is small: cite the real base commit, or describe the snapshot in a way that does not depend on rebuilt history, such as the parent of the commit that adds revision 2.
